## Pull request overview

This PR updates GitHub Actions CI workflows to stop using `pnpm/action-setup@v6` (which is causing lockfile parse failures) and instead rely on Node’s Corepack to provision the repo-pinned pnpm version via `packageManager` in `package.json`.

**Changes:**
- Replaced `pnpm/action-setup@v6` with `corepack enable` across the affected workflows.
- Added a `pnpm --version` verification step after enabling Corepack.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 12 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | Switches pnpm setup in all CI jobs from `pnpm/action-setup` to Corepack + version verification. |
| .github/workflows/lint.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification. |
| .github/workflows/release.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification in release pipeline. |
| .github/workflows/changeset-release.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for changesets release flow. |
| .github/workflows/performance-budget.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for bundle analysis. |
| .github/workflows/shadcn-check.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for shadcn sync checks. |
| .github/workflows/storybook-deploy.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for Storybook build/deploy. |
| .github/workflows/storybook-tests.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for Storybook CI tests. |
| .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml | Replaces pnpm setup with Corepack + version verification for Dependabot automerge flow. |
</details>

`corepack enable` (and `pnpm --version`) are executed before `actions/setup-node`. Since `setup-node` updates the Node binary on PATH, the Corepack-enabled `pnpm` shim may be created against the runner's preinstalled Node and then disappear/break once Node is switched, causing later `pnpm install` (and/or pnpm caching) to fail. Move the Node setup step before enabling Corepack and verifying pnpm so Corepack uses the configured Node version.

`corepack enable` / `pnpm --version` run before `actions/setup-node`. After `setup-node` changes PATH to a different Node installation, the Corepack-enabled pnpm shim may no longer be available, breaking subsequent pnpm commands. Reorder so `actions/setup-node` runs first, then `corepack enable`, then `pnpm --version`.

`corepack enable` / `pnpm --version` are executed before `actions/setup-node`. If `setup-node` switches the Node version on PATH, the Corepack-enabled pnpm shim may not be present afterwards, which can break the later `pnpm install` and Playwright steps. Run `actions/setup-node` first, then enable Corepack and verify pnpm.

In the conditional docs job, `corepack enable` / `pnpm --version` run before `actions/setup-node` under the same `if`. Once `setup-node` updates PATH to its Node install, the Corepack-enabled pnpm shim may no longer be available, breaking `pnpm install` and later steps. Reorder the conditional steps so Node is set up first, then Corepack/pnpm verification.

Since `setup-node` changes the Node binary on PATH, this can leave you with a pnpm shim tied to the runner's preinstalled Node (or none after the switch), causing later pnpm commands to fail. Run `actions/setup-node` first, then enable Corepack and verify pnpm.
